stories.title: Tennessee: Supreme Court erlaubt Hinrichtung von Christa Pike – Vollstreckung scheitert offenbar

en.title: Tennessee: Supreme Court allows execution of Christa Pike – execution apparently fails
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court authorized the execution of convicted murderer Christa Pike in Tennessee. According to reports, two lethal injections were administered, but Pike remained alive after the procedure.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Musk soll für Pentagon „Zukunft der Kriegsführung“ erforschen

en.title: USA News Blog: Musk to Research "Future of Warfare" for Pentagon
en.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth wants to engage Elon Musk to advance the development of autonomous warfare capabilities for the Pentagon.

stories.title: Supreme Court erlaubt Hinrichtung von Frau in Tennessee

en.title: Supreme Court allows execution of woman in Tennessee
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that the death sentence against Christa Pike is lawful and the execution is to proceed shortly, following a previous last-minute halt to the proceedings.

stories.title: Kanye West: Konzerte von Ye in St. Petersburg abgesagt

en.title: Kanye West: Concerts by Ye in St. Petersburg cancelled
en.summary: Kanye West's scheduled performances in St. Petersburg have been cancelled. He would have been the biggest international star to perform in Russia since the Ukraine war began.

stories.title: Flydubai: Benjamin Netanyahu würdigt Piloten nach Angriff als »wahren Helden«

en.title: Flydubai: Benjamin Netanyahu commends pilot after attack as "true hero"
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu praised a Flydubai aircraft captain for preventing a catastrophe following an attack. Passengers, including one who reportedly subdued an alleged attacker in the cockpit, have since come forward with accounts.

stories.title: Schweizer Gletscher: Forscher sehen 2026 beispiellosen Eisschwund

en.title: Swiss glaciers: Researchers see unprecedented ice loss by 2026
en.summary: Swiss glaciers are melting at an unprecedented rate, losing nearly a fifth of their mass in five years during the warmest summer since 1864. Some researchers consider their eventual disappearance inevitable.

stories.title: KlimaKrise: Schweizer Gletscher verloren 2026 mehr als fünf Prozent Eis

en.title: Climate crisis: Swiss glaciers lost more than five percent ice in 2026
en.summary: Glacier researchers describe 2026 as a catastrophic year for Alpine glaciers. Under current conditions, these glaciers lack the capacity to survive long-term.

stories.title: Eilantrag abgelehnt: Oberstes US-Gericht genehmigt Hinrichtung von Frau in Tennessee

en.title: Emergency petition rejected: US Supreme Court approves execution of woman in Tennessee
en.summary: Tennessee was set to carry out its first female execution in over 200 years, but the execution was halted by court order shortly before proceeding. The Supreme Court has now ruled on the emergency petition.

stories.title: Elon Musk und Pentagon: Techmilliardär soll zentrale Rolle bei »Projekt Meridian« spielen

en.title: Elon Musk and Pentagon: Tech billionaire to play central role in "Project Meridian"
en.summary: US Defense Secretary Hegseth is advancing a project researching autonomous warfare, with Elon Musk taking a central role in the Pentagon initiative.

stories.title: Pressefreiheit: Nachrichtenseite „T24“ in der Türkei wegen „LGBT-Propaganda“ gesperrt

en.title: Press freedom: News site "T24" blocked in Turkey over "LGBT propaganda"
en.summary: Censorship in Turkey continues to increase as access to one of the country's largest news websites has been blocked.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Verlässt Portugals Nationalteam – Rücktritt offen

en.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Leaves Portugal National Team – Retirement Open
en.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo departed Portugal's national team training camp after being benched. The 41-year-old indicated he would explain his decision at a later time.

stories.title: Nikkei: Hohe Anleiherenditen dämpfen Zinshoffnung an Asiens Börsen

en.title: Nikkei: High bond yields dampen interest rate hopes at Asian exchanges
en.summary: US 10-year bond yields have reached 5.3 percent, the highest level in 24 years. Despite this, the Nikkei gained more than two percent, driven by Micron's quarterly results.

en.title: Guest commentary - Global Challenges: Germany lacks what Canada already has in the new world order
en.summary: According to security expert Sophie Eisentraut, Canada believes in the influence of middle powers and manages to convey confidence to its population better than Germany does.

stories.title: Sicherheit: Eigenverantwortlich forschen mit Militärunis aus China? So schützen die Bundesländer ihre Forschung vor Spionage

en.title: Security: Independent research with military universities from China? How German states protect their research from espionage
en.summary: A new platform aims to protect research knowledge from foreign powers. A Handelsblatt survey reveals that German states show varying levels of interest in this protection despite significant risks.

en.title: Life Insurance: How Germany's Largest Life Insurers Stand Financially
en.summary: A new study examines the financial position of major German life insurers as pension reform increases competition in the sector, identifying which providers are well-positioned for future challenges.
